title: Default Offering and Setup
content:
Current build and deploy pipeline has support for basic functionality required when developing software. The primary focus of this page is to describe the tool chain used to implement e.g. Continuous Integration.

Tools used:

GitHub is used for versioning of code and infrastructure. GitHub’s Pull Request functionality is used to collaborate and quality assure changes to the code base.

Azure DevOps consists of several services. The two services used is Azure Pipelines to handle logic when software is built and deployed and Azure Artifacts to store the build results

Jira is used to plan, track and release software. Software development done to implement or solve a Jira issue is linked reported back via integration to GitHub.
